source: Quran.com text_uthmani as shown on quran.com 16:68 and 16:69 (fetched 2026-11-13 via api.quran.com/api/v4/quran/verses/uthmani). 16:69 is quoted only from its first clause (the excerpt used in the video); re-run verse_check before publishing.

verses.16:68: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
verses.16:69_first_clause: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا

title: ٱلنَّحْلِ

phrases.en: Then eat from all the fruits.
Follow the ways of your Lord.
phrases.note: fasluki (fem. sg. imperative); rabbiki (your Lord, fem. 'your')
